disclaimer: Not medical advice. Estimates can be off by 10% or more. Consult a qualified professional before changing your diet.
common.name: Name
activity.sedentary.desc: Little or no exercise, desk job
activity.extra.desc: Very hard training plus a physical job
ffmi.notBanded.detail: These ranges come from studies of men and are not validated for women. The number is shown on its own.
ffmi.men.detail: Informal coaching ranges for men, not a medical category.
plan.formula.mifflinMale: Mifflin–St Jeor with the male constant (+5), which you chose because sex was left unspecified.
plan.formula.mifflinFemale: Mifflin–St Jeor with the female constant (−161), which you chose because sex was left unspecified.
plan.formula.mifflinAverage: Mifflin–St Jeor with an average constant (−78), because sex was left unspecified. You can pick the male or female constant instead.
plan.formula.katch: Katch–McArdle, because body fat is entered. Lean or muscular people are often closer to this estimate.
plan.block.pregnant: A calorie deficit is not offered during pregnancy or breastfeeding. Please talk with your clinician.
plan.block.bmi: BMI is {{bmi}}, under 18.5. A cut is not offered. Maintenance or a surplus is available, and a clinician is the right next step.
plan.capReason: The 20% cut would pass a safety limit, so the target is held at {{kcal}} kcal. The tightest limit is {{offset}} kcal under maintenance.
sexConstant.average: Sex is unspecified, so an average formula is used (Mifflin–St Jeor with a −78 constant). You can pick the male or female constant instead. The calorie floor stays 1,500 kcal.
sexConstant.chosenMale: You chose the male constant (+5) for Mifflin–St Jeor. The calorie floor stays 1,500 kcal.
sexConstant.chosenFemale: You chose the female constant (−161) for Mifflin–St Jeor. The calorie floor stays 1,500 kcal.
targets.carbsUnder50: Carbs are under 50 g. That is very low for most people. Consider raising calories or lowering fat or protein. This is a warning, not a block.
targets.carbsUnder100: Carbs are under 100 g. That can be hard to sustain. This is a warning, not a block.
targets.proteinHigh: Protein is about {{pct}}% of your calories, above the 35% most guidelines treat as the upper end. This is only a note, you can still save.
targets.macrosAbove: Protein, carbs, and fat add up to {{energy}} kcal, which is above the {{kcal}} kcal target.
targets.macrosBelow: Protein, carbs, and fat add up to {{energy}} kcal, which is below the {{kcal}} kcal target. About {{gap}} kcal is not assigned to any macro.
targets.kcalZero: Calorie target has to be above 0.
targets.kcalTooHigh: That target is above {{max}} kcal. Enter a smaller number.
targets.kcalFloor: That is below the {{floor}} kcal floor for this profile. {{floor}} kcal is the lowest target Macroyo will save.
targets.tooHigh.proteinG: Protein is above {{max}} g. Check the number.
targets.tooHigh.carbsG: Carbs is above {{max}} g. Check the number.
targets.tooHigh.fatG: Fat is above {{max}} g. Check the number.
targets.fatFloor: Fat is below the floor of {{grams}} g (the larger of 20% of calories and 0.6 g/kg).
targets.fatBelowCutDefault: Fat is below the {{grams}} g (0.8 g/kg) Macroyo suggests on a cut. This is a warning, not a block.
validate.age.underage: Macroyo is for adults 18 and older. Calorie targets and body-composition numbers are not appropriate under 18.
validate.height.range: Enter a height from 100 to 250 cm.
validate.weight.range: Enter a weight from 30 to 300 kg.
validate.bodyImplausible: Together these numbers give a resting energy of only {{bmr}} kcal a day, which is not realistic. Please check your age, height and weight.
validate.bodyFat.range: Enter body fat from 3 to 60%, or leave it blank.
validate.portion.range: Enter a portion from just above 0 g up to 5,000 g.
validate.noThousands: Type the number without a thousands separator, like 180 or 80.5.
validate.typed.range.age: Enter an age from {{min}} to {{max}} years.
validate.typed.range.height.cm: Enter a height from {{min}} to {{max}} cm.
validate.typed.range.height.in: Enter a height from {{min}} to {{max}} in.
validate.typed.range.weight.kg: Enter a weight from {{min}} to {{max}} kg.
validate.typed.range.weight.lb: Enter a weight from {{min}} to {{max}} lb.
offset.invalid: Enter a number of kcal, like 300 or -300.
quickAdd.name.tooLong: Use a name of 200 characters or fewer.
quickAdd.kcal.tooHigh: One entry cannot be over 10,000 kcal.
quickAdd.missing.proteinG: Enter protein as a number, or 0.
quickAdd.missing.carbsG: Enter carbs as a number, or 0.
quickAdd.missing.fatG: Enter fat as a number, or 0.
quickAdd.tooHigh.proteinG: Protein is above 2,000 g. Check the number.
quickAdd.tooHigh.carbsG: Carbs is above 2,000 g. Check the number.
quickAdd.tooHigh.fatG: Fat is above 2,000 g. Check the number.
quickAdd.tooHigh.fiberG: Fiber is above 2,000 g. Check the number.
quickAdd.fiber.notNumber: Enter fiber as a number, or leave it blank if you do not know it.
quickAdd.macrosExceedPortion: Protein, carbs and fat add up to {{total}} g, which is more than the {{grams}} g portion. Check the numbers or raise the portion.
quickAdd.mismatch: Those macros add up to about {{energy}} kcal, not {{kcal}}.
limit.bmi: BMI is already at or below 18.5
projection.deficitUnavailable: Your maintenance calories are already close to the minimum safe intake, so a calorie deficit isn't recommended. Consider more activity, or talk to a professional.
projection.bmiAtFloor: BMI is already at or below 18.5; no deficit projection.
projection.offsetClamped: Requested deficit {{requested}} kcal/day exceeds the safe maximum {{cap}} kcal/day (1% body weight/week, 25% of TDEE, calorie floor); projection uses {{used}}.
projection.surplusFat.abs: Large surplus (> +500 kcal): much of the gain will be fat, not muscle.
projection.surplusFat.pct: Large surplus (> 15% of TDEE): much of the gain will be fat, not muscle.
projection.surplusFat.both: Large surplus (> +500 kcal and > 15% of TDEE): much of the gain will be fat, not muscle.
projection.bmiFloorReached: Projection stopped at a healthy minimum BMI ({{weight}} kg) from {{horizon}} onward.
storage.saveFailed: Could not save on this device. Your last change was not applied.
storage.readFailed: Saved data could not be read. A backup copy was kept and nothing new will be saved until you reset the app data.
storage.eraseUnreadable: Erase unreadable data and start fresh
onboarding.tagline: Log meals fast. Hit your macros. Know your numbers.
onboarding.sexNote: Sex is used only for the energy equation.
onboarding.chooseSex: Choose a sex option. Unspecified uses an average equation.
onboarding.adultsBody: Calorie targets and body-composition indexes are not built for people under 18. If you are under 18, please talk with a parent or guardian and a clinician. You can correct the age above if it was a typo.
onboarding.bmiLine: BMI {{bmi}} from the numbers you entered.
onboarding.splitNote: Suggested split is about {{protein}} g protein ({{perKg}} g/kg), {{fat}} g fat, {{carbs}} g carbs. Fiber is a soft goal of {{fiber}} g. Macros at those grams are {{kcal}} kcal.
onboarding.proteinLimited: Protein was limited to 35% of calories ({{protein}} g instead of {{uncapped}} g from {{perKg}} g/kg), because that body weight over-counts protein on a lower target.
onboarding.fatTrimmed: Fat was lowered toward its minimum so carbs would not go below zero.
plan.macroOvershoot: Protein and fat alone already reach the {{kcal}} kcal target, so carbs are set to 0. Consider a higher calorie target.
today.title: Today
today.emptyBody: Log your first meal and it will show up here, grouped by breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snack.
today.itemDetail: {{grams}} g · {{kcal}} kcal · P {{p}} · C {{c}} · F {{f}} · fiber {{fiber}}

log.title: Log
log.searchHint_one: Search {{count}} food. USDA names work in any order, so “baked bacon” finds “Bacon, baked”.
log.searchHint_other: Search {{count}} foods. USDA names work in any order, so “baked bacon” finds “Bacon, baked”.
log.resultDetail: {{kcal}} kcal / 100 g · P {{p}} · C {{c}} · F {{f}} · fiber {{fiber}}
log.fixOrSave: Fix the numbers, or save it as entered.
calc.title: Calc
calc.fixEntry: Fix the highlighted entry to see results. Nothing below is calculated from an invalid number.
calc.bmi.note: BMI does not tell muscle from fat. That is what FFMI is for.
calc.ffmi.enterBodyFat: Enter body fat to see FFMI. Without it the number would not mean anything.
calc.ffmi.maleReference: Bands shown are from male reference data.
calc.ffmi.formula: Lean mass {{lean}} kg. FFMI = lean ÷ height². Normalized FFMI = FFMI + 6.1 × (1.8 − height in m).
calc.customInvalid: {{message}} Nothing is applied until the number is valid.
calc.capApplied: That deficit is above the maximum of {{cap}} kcal, so the projection uses the cap.
calc.effectiveOffset: Effective offset {{offset}} kcal/day · {{pct}}% of body weight per week. Every number is an estimate.
calc.mostlyFat: Most of this surplus will be fat.
calc.clampedNote: Stopped at a healthy minimum BMI
calc.horizonNote: Real weight change slows over time as a lighter body burns less energy. The first week and month hold the gap steady. From 3 months on, maintenance is recomputed each week. Scale weight also moves with water and glycogen.
calc.saved: Saved to progress. Your profile was left unchanged.
trends.title: Trends
trends.weightEmpty: No weigh-ins yet. Save one from Calc (Body → Save to progress) and your trend line starts here. One entry is enough.
trends.weightLegend: Dots are weigh-ins; the thin line is a 7-entry trailing average.
trends.weightLatestChange: Latest {{weight}} kg · {{date}} · change {{change}} kg in this range
trends.weightChartLabel_one: Weight chart, {{count}} weigh-in from {{from}} to {{to}} kilograms
trends.weightChartLabel_other: Weight chart, {{count}} weigh-ins from {{from}} to {{to}} kilograms
trends.caloriesEmpty: No meals logged in this range. Log a few and each day shows up as a bar against your target.
trends.last30: Last 30 days, chart shows up to 30
trends.caloriesCaption: {{range}} · target {{target}} kcal (solid line){{average}}. Bars turn amber when a day is over target.

trends.caloriesChartLabelTarget_other: Calories per day for {{count}} days, target {{target}}
